0022600001.text: The Pistons open their 2026-27 season at home against the Boston Celtics, who have also not yet played a game this season. Detroit won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, and their most recent meeting was a 104-103 home win on January 19, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Pistons a 50% chance of winning.
